# tailor_telemetryrouter_resource_attributes_config (Resource)

The telemetryrouter_resource_attributes_config resource configures the workspace-level resource
attributes that are enriched onto every outgoing OpenTelemetry signal. It is a singleton: a
workspace has at most one resource attributes configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tailor_telemetryrouter_resource_attributes_config" "this" {
  workspace_id = tailor_workspace.example.id

  service_name_prefix         = "acme"
  deployment_environment_name = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_name_prefix` (String) Prefix prepended to each microservice's own service.name to form the final service.name resource
attribute on outgoing signals ("<service_name_prefix>-<service.name>"). Must match the pattern
^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace this resource attributes configuration belongs to.

### Optional

- `deployment_environment_name` (String) Customer-side deployment environment (e.g. "production", "staging") following the OpenTelemetry
semantic convention deployment.environment.name. Optional; max 256 characters. When omitted, the
deployment.environment.name attribute is left untouched.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.
